title: 江戸八百八町・記憶の露店と星図の行商人
author: 藤堂 小太郎

en.title: Edo's Eight Hundred Eight Streets: The Memory Stall and the Star-Chart Peddler
en.premise: In a quiet corner of Edo, appearing only as night falls, lies the "Market of Sold Memories." Here, sorrows people wish to forget and warm memories thought lost are traded for a single coin. Seisuke, a young peddler wandering with a star chart in hand, enjoys the seasonal flavors of the city while drawing close to people's hearts, uncovering "treasures" that can never be bought or sold. This is a tale of memories and human warmth, woven by the stylish folk of Edo.

zh.title: 江户八百八町：记忆露天摊与星图行商
zh.premise: 在江户的角落里，仅于夜幕低垂时分现身的“贩卖记忆之市”。在那里，人们想要忘却的悲伤与本应失去的温暖回忆，正以一枚铜钱的价格进行着交易。手持星图游走的年轻行电商助，在品尝季节美味的同时，贴近人们的心灵，找寻着那些无法作为商品出售的“宝物”。这是一部由洒脱的江户儿女交织而成的，关于记忆与人情的故事。
